title: Minimax Estimation of Ramp-Smoothed Benefit Prevalence from Category CATEs with Rare Strata
banked_reason: The proposal's explicit all-regime Stat frontier with an attaining estimator and honest interval remains a to-prove question; the current artifact supplies a partial bracket and selected regimes, not the promised computable matched frontier.
gap_reasons: The proposal's explicit all-regime Stat frontier with an attaining estimator and honest interval remains a to-prove question; the current artifact supplies a partial bracket and selected regimes, not the promised computable matched frontier.

Outside the solved regimes, min{1,d/[n log(ed)t^2]} is only an upper bound: the matching risk lower bound, honest-length converse, critical resolution scales, and therefore the advertised joint frontier remain open.
The framing accurately discloses these limitations and does not falsely claim that the full frontier is established.
proof_attempt_summary: D0 developed the signed-response and paired-hinge reductions, fixed-alphabet and resolved-kink results, and a sufficient weak-signal saturation regime. D0.5 passed the math panel but found the promised all-regime risk and honest-interval frontier still open; the uniform paired-hinge converse and its causal fixed-sample transfer remain the main research task. The field novelty floor was not met; the cold review assigned incremental tier.
tldr: A fair randomized trial with a prespecified categorical partition, binary outcomes, and occupied-stratum arm means in \[1/4,3/4\] identifies the population-weighted ramp of category CATEs, but arbitrary rare strata and shrinking public resolution produce a nonstandard three-parameter estimation problem. This note proves the exact signed-response and paired-hinge reductions, a uniform shifted-value upper bound, exact fixed-alphabet rates, a resolved-kink dense frontier, and weak-signal saturation in a sufficient regime. It does not determine the full \(n,d,t\) phase diagram. Two linked questions remain open: the constrained paired-hinge separation modulus under fixed-mean, exact-normalization, and interior-mean constraints (\(\mathrm{oeq:paired\mbox{-}hinge\mbox{-}duality}\)), and the resulting all-regime minimax risk and honest connected-interval frontier (\(\mathrm{oeq:joint\mbox{-}frontier}\)).
gap: Smoothed CATE-distribution papers give influence-function or local-asymptotic inference, and discrete-functional papers give polynomial tools for one cusp or generic additive targets. None determines a uniform finite-sample frontier jointly in sample size, stratum count, and shrinking clinical resolution, or the matching expected length of an honest connected interval, when stratum masses may be arbitrarily small.
fill: The formal objective is an explicit numerical frontier \(F_\star(n,d,t)\), a fully data-only estimator and uniformly \(90\%\)-honest connected interval attaining it, and matching lower bounds against every randomized procedure. The proof program retains the verified fixed-alphabet and resolved-kink regimes and makes the paired-hinge separation modulus the visible open mathematical object.
